note: A = outgoing shot 前一镜头, B = incoming shot 后一镜头

how.zh: 1 选A结束与B开始动作点。2 删除缝隙直接拼接。3 检查视线、动作与声音。
how.en: 1 Choose the end point of A and the start point of B. 2 Remove the gap and butt them together. 3 Check eyeline, action and sound.

use_when.zh: 对白、纪录片、信息密集内容
use_when.en: Dialogue, documentary, information-dense content

effect.zh: 干净直接，保持叙事节奏。
effect.en: Clean and direct; keeps the narrative pace.

prompt.zh: A结束后直接硬切B，保持动作连续，不加过渡。
prompt.en: Hard cut from the end of A straight to B, keep the action continuous, no transition effect.

pitfalls.zh: 先保证镜头逻辑成立。
pitfalls.en: Make sure the shot logic works first.

how.zh: 1 找动作进行中的切点。2 B从同一动作后续接入。3 逐帧修剪重复或缺失动作。
how.en: 1 Find a cut point mid-action. 2 Bring B in on the continuation of the same action. 3 Trim frame by frame to remove repeated or missing motion.

use_when.zh: 开门、转身、拿取、运动
use_when.en: Opening doors, turning, picking things up, sport

effect.zh: 用动作引导注意，让切点不显眼。
effect.en: Uses movement to lead the eye so the cut goes unnoticed.

prompt.zh: 在A抬手中途切B的后续动作，匹配方向和速度。
prompt.en: Cut from A mid-way through raising the hand to B continuing the motion; match direction and speed.

pitfalls.zh: 动作阶段和轴线需一致。
pitfalls.en: Action phase and screen axis must match.

how.zh: 1 选相似轮廓。2 调位置、比例、旋转以对齐。3 在构图最相近处切换。
how.en: 1 Pick similar silhouettes. 2 Align position, scale and rotation. 3 Cut where the compositions are closest.

use_when.zh: 品牌标志、圆形物件、跨时代叙事
use_when.en: Brand logos, round objects, cross-era storytelling

effect.zh: 建立视觉联系或比喻。
effect.en: Creates a visual link or metaphor.

prompt.zh: 将A的圆形主体对齐B的圆形主体，匹配大小后硬切。
prompt.en: Align the round subject in A with the round subject in B, match size, then hard cut.

pitfalls.zh: 保持主体落点一致，避免额外变形。
pitfalls.en: Keep the subject's position identical; avoid extra distortion.

how.zh: 1 找主色相似镜头。2 校正色温、亮度。3 在相同色块占据视野时切B。
how.en: 1 Find shots with a similar dominant colour. 2 Correct colour temperature and brightness. 3 Cut to B when the same colour fills the frame.

use_when.zh: 时尚、美食、旅行、品牌色
use_when.en: Fashion, food, travel, brand colours

effect.zh: 跨场景仍保持色彩连续。
effect.en: Keeps colour continuity across scenes.

prompt.zh: 在A与B主色一致时硬切，统一亮度与色温。
prompt.en: Hard cut when A and B share the same dominant colour; unify brightness and colour temperature.

pitfalls.zh: 颜色匹配不等于两个镜头套同一LUT。
pitfalls.en: Colour matching is not the same as applying one LUT to both shots.

how.zh: 1 找同方向运动。2 校准速度与主体位置。3 在运动相位相近处切换。
how.en: 1 Find movement in the same direction. 2 Align speed and subject position. 3 Cut where the motion phases are closest.

use_when.zh: 抛接、旋转商品、运动集锦
use_when.en: Throws and catches, rotating products, sports montages

effect.zh: 把不同场景接成同一股动势。
effect.en: Joins different scenes into one continuous momentum.

prompt.zh: A向右运动接B向右运动，匹配速度和主体位置后切换。
prompt.en: A moving right cuts to B moving right; match speed and subject position, then cut.

pitfalls.zh: 可跨场景；不同于同一动作的连续接切。
pitfalls.en: Can cross scenes; different from a continuity cut on the same action.

how.zh: 1 固定同机位素材。2 删停顿或中间时间。3 保留有意的姿态跳变。
how.en: 1 Use footage from the same camera position. 2 Remove pauses or intervening time. 3 Keep the intentional jump in pose.

use_when.zh: 口播、教程、时间压缩
use_when.en: Talking-head videos, tutorials, time compression

effect.zh: 提速并强调时间跳跃。
effect.en: Speeds things up and emphasises the passage of time.

prompt.zh: 删除A中的停顿，保留同机位跳切，语句衔接自然。
prompt.en: Remove the pauses in A, keep same-angle jump cuts, and make the sentences flow naturally.

pitfalls.zh: 需接受明显跳变，避免剪断词尾。
pitfalls.en: Accept the visible jump; don't clip the ends of words.

how.zh: 1 选情绪或声音反差大的两段。2 卡反应点硬切。3 同步切换或突停声音。
how.en: 1 Pick two segments with strong emotional or sonic contrast. 2 Hard cut on the reaction point. 3 Switch or cut the sound abruptly at the same moment.

use_when.zh: 喜剧反转、梦醒、强烈情绪变化
use_when.en: Comedic reversals, waking from a dream, sharp mood shifts

effect.zh: 制造惊讶、反讽或冲击。
effect.en: Creates surprise, irony or impact.

prompt.zh: 从A的喧闹瞬间硬切B的安静，声音同步骤停。
prompt.en: Hard cut from the loudest moment of A to the silence of B; the sound stops at the same instant.

pitfalls.zh: 叙事应支持反差，不只为炫技。
pitfalls.en: The story should justify the contrast; don't do it just to show off.

how.zh: 1 在A删改处插相关细节。2 原对白连续播放。3 接回主镜头或进入B。
how.en: 1 Insert a relevant detail over the edit point in A. 2 Keep the original dialogue playing continuously. 3 Cut back to the main shot or into B.

use_when.zh: 采访删句、教学、纪录片
use_when.en: Removing lines from interviews, tutorials, documentary

effect.zh: 遮住画面跳切并补充信息。
effect.en: Hides the jump cut and adds information.

prompt.zh: 在A的删句处插入相关细节B，保持对白连续。
prompt.en: Insert related detail shot B over the removed line in A; keep the dialogue continuous.

pitfalls.zh: 这是镜头组织技巧，不是软件特效。
pitfalls.en: This is a shot-structure technique, not a software effect.

how.zh: 1 分开音画剪辑点。2 B声音先于B画面进入。3 平衡交接处音量。
how.en: 1 Split the audio and video edit points. 2 Let B's sound start before B's picture. 3 Balance levels across the handover.

use_when.zh: 采访、进入新地点、悬念预告
use_when.en: Interviews, arriving at a new location, suspenseful teasers

effect.zh: 先用声音引导观众期待。
effect.en: Uses sound to set up the viewer's expectation.

prompt.zh: B的声音提前0.5秒进入，再从A切到B画面。
prompt.en: Bring B's audio in 0.5 s early, then cut from A to B's picture.

pitfalls.zh: 需提供可独立编辑的B音轨。
pitfalls.en: Requires an independently editable B audio track.

how.zh: 1 先将画面切B。2 A对白或环境声继续。3 在自然句尾淡出A音轨。
how.en: 1 Cut the picture to B first. 2 Let A's dialogue or ambience continue. 3 Fade out A's audio at a natural sentence end.

use_when.zh: 访谈反应镜头、旁白配B-roll
use_when.en: Interview reaction shots, voice-over over B-roll

effect.zh: 保留情绪和语义连续。
effect.en: Preserves emotional and semantic continuity.

prompt.zh: 先切到B画面，A的对白继续至句尾后淡出。
prompt.en: Cut to B's picture first; let A's dialogue continue to the end of the sentence, then fade out.

pitfalls.zh: 避免与B对白互相遮盖。
pitfalls.en: Avoid A's audio masking B's dialogue.

how.zh: 1 选可跨场景延续的声音。2 把声音铺过画面切点。3 混入B环境声。
how.en: 1 Pick a sound that can carry across scenes. 2 Lay it over the picture cut. 3 Mix in B's ambience.

use_when.zh: 跨地域蒙太奇、回忆、主题关联
use_when.en: Cross-location montages, flashbacks, thematic links

effect.zh: 听觉上连结两个空间。
effect.en: Connects two spaces through sound.

prompt.zh: 用同一段雨声贯穿A到B，在B中逐渐混入新环境声。
prompt.en: Carry the same rain sound from A into B, gradually mixing in B's new ambience.

pitfalls.zh: 与J/L cut有关，但不要求使用对白。
pitfalls.en: Related to J/L-cuts but doesn't require dialogue.

how.zh: 1 保留两段额外素材。2 重叠A尾B头。3 A透明度降、B升并检查重影。
how.en: 1 Keep extra handles on both clips. 2 Overlap A's tail with B's head. 3 Fade A's opacity down and B's up; check for ghosting.

use_when.zh: 时间流逝、回忆、舒缓风景
use_when.en: Passage of time, memories, calm landscapes

effect.zh: 柔和过渡，暗示时间关系。
effect.en: Soft transition that implies a time relationship.

prompt.zh: A与B做0.6秒交叉叠化，曝光平稳。
prompt.en: 0.6 s cross dissolve from A to B with steady exposure.

pitfalls.zh: 两张人脸叠在一起可能产生杂乱重影。
pitfalls.en: Two overlapping faces can produce messy ghosting.

how.zh: 1 A渐暗至黑。2 可短暂停黑。3 B从黑恢复正常曝光。
how.en: 1 Fade A down to black. 2 Optionally hold on black briefly. 3 Bring B up from black to normal exposure.

use_when.zh: 章节结束、时间跨度大、段落分隔
use_when.en: End of a chapter, large time jumps, section breaks

effect.zh: 产生停顿与明确段落感。
effect.en: Creates a pause and a clear sense of sections.

prompt.zh: A用0.3秒淡至黑，再用0.3秒淡入B。
prompt.en: Fade A to black over 0.3 s, then fade into B over 0.3 s.

pitfalls.zh: 频繁淡黑容易被误读为结束。
pitfalls.en: Frequent dips to black can be mistaken for the ending.

how.zh: 1 提亮A尾。2 在白峰值切B。3 B迅速恢复曝光。
how.en: 1 Brighten A's tail. 2 Cut to B at peak white. 3 Bring B back to normal exposure quickly.

use_when.zh: 闪光灯、回忆触发、音乐卡点
use_when.en: Camera flashes, memory triggers, music beats

effect.zh: 瞬间冲击，遮盖场景变化。
effect.en: Instant impact that masks the scene change.

prompt.zh: A闪白后切B，0.2秒内恢复正常曝光，只闪一次。
prompt.en: Flash A to white then cut to B, return to normal exposure within 0.2 s, flash only once.

pitfalls.zh: 大面积连续闪烁应避免。
pitfalls.en: Avoid repeated full-screen flashing.

how.zh: 1 叠放A和B。2 用A亮度作遮罩。3 动画化阈值，让明暗区域依次显露B。
how.en: 1 Stack A and B. 2 Use A's luminance as a matte. 3 Animate the threshold so B appears through light and dark areas in turn.

use_when.zh: 天空、山脉、高反差轮廓
use_when.en: Skies, mountains, high-contrast silhouettes

effect.zh: 按画面结构逐层出现，较普通叠化更有层次。
effect.en: Reveals in layers that follow the image structure; richer than a plain dissolve.

prompt.zh: A按亮部到暗部依次显露B，亮度溶解0.6秒。
prompt.en: Reveal B through A from highlights to shadows; 0.6 s luma fade.

pitfalls.zh: 低反差素材需调整阈值与边缘柔和度。
pitfalls.en: Low-contrast footage needs threshold and edge softness adjusted.

how.zh: 1 漏光素材放在两镜头上方。2 用滤色或加亮混合。3 最亮处对齐切点并淡出。
how.en: 1 Place light-leak footage above both clips. 2 Use Screen or Add blending. 3 Align the brightest point with the cut, then fade out.

use_when.zh: 婚礼、旅行、复古生活方式
use_when.en: Weddings, travel, retro lifestyle

effect.zh: 暖色光晕和胶片质感。
effect.en: Warm glow and film texture.

prompt.zh: 在A到B切点叠加一次暖色漏光，峰值遮住切点，0.5秒。
prompt.en: Overlay one warm light leak at the A-to-B cut, peak covering the cut, 0.5 s.

pitfalls.zh: 漏光应像光线变化，不要盖住重要信息。
pitfalls.en: The leak should feel like a change in light and must not cover key information.

how.zh: 1 加灼烧纹理或程序效果。2 扩展亮边与不规则遮罩。3 烧穿A后露出B。
how.en: 1 Add a burn texture or procedural effect. 2 Expand bright edges and an irregular matte. 3 Burn through A to reveal B.

use_when.zh: 复古MV、回忆、胶片风广告
use_when.en: Retro music videos, flashbacks, film-look ads

effect.zh: 有机、粗粝的材质变化。
effect.en: Organic, gritty material change.

prompt.zh: A从边缘被暖色胶片灼烧覆盖，0.5秒后露出B。
prompt.en: A is overtaken by a warm film burn from the edges, revealing B after 0.5 s.

pitfalls.zh: 区别于均匀闪白，需有不规则纹理。
pitfalls.en: Unlike a uniform flash, it needs an irregular texture.

how.zh: 1 A结尾向右快速甩镜。2 B开头同向甩入。3 在模糊最大处切并配短whoosh。
how.en: 1 End A with a fast whip to the right. 2 Start B whipping in from the same direction. 3 Cut at peak blur and add a short whoosh.

use_when.zh: 旅行、运动、快节奏B-roll
use_when.en: Travel, sport, fast-paced B-roll

effect.zh: 快速横向动势，隐藏切点。
effect.en: Fast lateral momentum that hides the cut.

prompt.zh: A向右甩镜接B同向甩入，在最大运动模糊处切换。
prompt.en: A whips right into B whipping in from the same direction; cut at peak motion blur.

pitfalls.zh: 同方向、近似速度与曝光；实拍优先预先设计。
pitfalls.en: Same direction, similar speed and exposure; plan it at the shoot when possible.

how.zh: 1 A推近手掌或深色物体。2 等画面完全被遮住。3 接B从相同遮挡退出。
how.en: 1 Push A into a hand or dark object. 2 Wait until the frame is fully covered. 3 Cut to B emerging from the same occlusion.

use_when.zh: 换装、空间穿越、伪一镜到底
use_when.en: Outfit changes, space travel, fake one-takes

effect.zh: 切点隐藏在遮挡内。
effect.en: The cut is hidden inside the occlusion.

prompt.zh: A被黑色衣物完全遮住时切B，B从同一遮挡后连续退出。
prompt.en: Cut to B when A is fully covered by black clothing; B continues out from behind the same occlusion.

pitfalls.zh: 必须真的满屏，运动与遮挡颜色需匹配。
pitfalls.en: Must truly fill the frame; match movement and occluder colour.

how.zh: 1 将B放A下方。2 跟踪A前景经过的边缘。3 动画蒙版沿边缘露出B。
how.en: 1 Put B below A. 2 Track the edge of a foreground object passing through A. 3 Animate a mask along that edge to reveal B.

use_when.zh: 经过柱子、车辆、行人、门框
use_when.en: Passing pillars, vehicles, pedestrians, door frames

effect.zh: 让场景像被前景物体自然擦走。
effect.en: The scene looks naturally wiped away by a foreground object.

prompt.zh: 跟踪A中从左向右经过的柱子，用其边缘擦出B。
prompt.en: Track the pillar moving left to right in A and use its edge to wipe in B.

pitfalls.zh: 需逐帧检查蒙版边缘与运动模糊。
pitfalls.en: Check mask edges and motion blur frame by frame.

how.zh: 1 复制并抠出主体。2 把主体层放最上方。3 背景先转B，主体再衔接。
how.en: 1 Duplicate and cut out the subject. 2 Put the subject layer on top. 3 Change the background to B first, then hand over the subject.

use_when.zh: 人物宣传、产品广告、时尚
use_when.en: Personal promos, product ads, fashion

effect.zh: 主体连续，背景空间突然改变。
effect.en: The subject stays continuous while the space around it changes abruptly.

prompt.zh: 保留A主体在前景，背景擦换为B，再自然接入B主体。
prompt.en: Keep A's subject in the foreground, wipe the background to B, then hand over naturally to B's subject.

pitfalls.zh: 头发、透明物体和遮挡需要修边。
pitfalls.en: Hair, transparent objects and overlaps need edge cleanup.

how.zh: 1 两镜头锚点对准同一位置。2 A尾快速放大并加径向模糊。3 B从放大状态恢复。
how.en: 1 Align both shots' anchor points on the same spot. 2 Rapidly scale up A's tail with radial blur. 3 Bring B back from the zoomed state.

use_when.zh: 商品细节、旅行景点、短视频卡点
use_when.en: Product details, travel landmarks, beat-synced short videos

effect.zh: 向前冲入下一画面。
effect.en: Pushes forward into the next shot.

prompt.zh: 围绕主体中心快速推近A，模糊峰值切B，0.4秒内稳定。
prompt.en: Quickly push in on A around the subject's centre, cut to B at peak blur, settle within 0.4 s.

pitfalls.zh: 先对齐视觉中心；避免露出边缘。
pitfalls.en: Align the visual centre first; don't reveal frame edges.

how.zh: 1 A快速缩小并模糊。2 B从较大比例接入。3 统一拉远方向并回到正常构图。
how.en: 1 Rapidly scale down and blur A. 2 Bring B in at a larger scale. 3 Keep the pull-out direction consistent and return to normal framing.

use_when.zh: 细节到全景、空间揭示、品牌片
use_when.en: Detail to wide, spatial reveals, brand films

effect.zh: 从局部释放到更大空间。
effect.en: Releases from the detail into a larger space.

prompt.zh: A快速拉远进入B全景，保持中心与拉远方向一致，0.4秒。
prompt.en: Quickly pull out of A into B's wide shot, keep centre and direction consistent, 0.4 s.

pitfalls.zh: 缩小A时需铺底或镜像扩边。
pitfalls.en: When shrinking A, fill the background or mirror-extend the edges.

how.zh: 1 A绕中心加速旋转。2 在模糊峰值切B。3 B同向减速落稳。
how.en: 1 Accelerate A rotating around its centre. 2 Cut to B at peak blur. 3 Decelerate B in the same direction until it settles.

use_when.zh: 舞蹈、运动、潮流广告
use_when.en: Dance, sport, trend-driven ads

effect.zh: 产生旋转动能与节奏冲击。
effect.en: Rotational energy and rhythmic impact.

prompt.zh: A顺时针旋转接B同向减速，加入运动模糊，0.4秒落稳。
prompt.en: A spins clockwise into B decelerating in the same direction, with motion blur, settling in 0.4 s.

pitfalls.zh: 补足画面边缘，不让主体无意义翻倒。
pitfalls.en: Fill the frame edges; don't let the subject flip over for no reason.

how.zh: 1 设时间重映射关键帧。2 A尾加速、B头同速接入。3 B渐慢至正常或慢动作。
how.en: 1 Set time-remapping keyframes. 2 Speed up A's tail and bring B in at the same speed. 3 Slow B down to normal or slow motion.

use_when.zh: 运动、商品B-roll、旅行
use_when.en: Sport, product B-roll, travel

effect.zh: 突出动作高光并提高节奏。
effect.en: Highlights the peak of the action and lifts the pace.

prompt.zh: A结尾加速，在速度峰值切B，B平滑减速至正常。
prompt.en: Speed up the end of A, cut to B at peak speed, B smoothly slows to normal.

pitfalls.zh: 源帧率限制慢放质量；速度曲线不是固定模板。
pitfalls.en: Source frame rate limits slow-mo quality; the speed curve is not a fixed template.

how.zh: 1 A逐渐失焦。2 选B失焦头部接入。3 B重新合焦；后期可用镜头模糊模拟。
how.en: 1 Rack A out of focus. 2 Bring B in on an out-of-focus head. 3 Rack B back into focus; lens blur can simulate it in post.

use_when.zh: 梦境、情绪、产品柔和揭示
use_when.en: Dreams, emotion, soft product reveals

effect.zh: 把场景变化藏在视觉模糊中。
effect.en: Hides the scene change inside visual blur.

prompt.zh: A逐渐失焦至全糊后切B，再合焦，合计0.6秒。
prompt.en: A gradually defocuses to full blur, cut to B, then refocus; 0.6 s total.

pitfalls.zh: 匹配两段模糊的色块与亮度。
pitfalls.en: Match the colour blocks and brightness of both blurred frames.

how.zh: 1 A、B重叠。2 方向模糊在中点升至峰值。3 叠化到B后消除模糊。
how.en: 1 Overlap A and B. 2 Ramp directional blur to a peak at the midpoint. 3 Dissolve to B and clear the blur.

use_when.zh: 科技、运动、平面动效
use_when.en: Tech, sport, motion graphics

effect.zh: 产生方向性速度感。
effect.en: Directional sense of speed.

prompt.zh: A到B做0.3秒水平模糊叠化，中点最模糊，两端清晰。
prompt.en: 0.3 s horizontal blur dissolve from A to B, blurriest at the midpoint, sharp at both ends.

pitfalls.zh: 与真实甩镜不同，可用静态镜头实现。
pitfalls.en: Unlike a real whip pan, it works with static shots.

how.zh: 1 动画化波纹位移。2 在波纹峰值混入B。3 减弱波纹使B稳定。
how.en: 1 Animate a ripple displacement. 2 Mix in B at the ripple peak. 3 Reduce the ripple until B is stable.

use_when.zh: 梦境、回忆、水主题、复古表达
use_when.en: Dreams, memories, water themes, retro looks

effect.zh: 空间像液体般波动。
effect.en: Space ripples like liquid.

prompt.zh: A出现轻微扩散水波并过渡到B，0.6秒恢复稳定。
prompt.en: A shows a gentle spreading ripple and transitions to B, stabilising within 0.6 s.

pitfalls.zh: 波纹过大易扭曲人脸。
pitfalls.en: Large ripples distort faces.

how.zh: 1 删除停顿。2 在近似姿势的两段间加Morph Cut。3 分析后检查嘴部、眼睛和背景。
how.en: 1 Remove the pause. 2 Add a Morph Cut between two segments with similar poses. 3 After analysis, check mouth, eyes and background.

use_when.zh: 静态机位采访、单人讲话
use_when.en: Locked-off interviews, single-speaker talks

effect.zh: 减轻删句造成的视觉跳动。
effect.en: Reduces the visual jump caused by removing lines.

prompt.zh: 为同机位口播跳切添加短Morph Cut，保持嘴型和背景稳定。
prompt.en: Add a short Morph Cut to the same-angle talking-head jump cut; keep mouth shape and background stable.

pitfalls.zh: 不同人物或大幅动作不适合。
pitfalls.en: Not suitable for different people or large movements.

how.zh: 1 切点附近加短RGB错位与横向位移。2 中间切B。3 快速归零效果。
how.en: 1 Add short RGB split and horizontal offset near the cut. 2 Cut to B in the middle. 3 Quickly return the effect to zero.

use_when.zh: 电竞、数码产品、故障情节
use_when.en: Esports, digital products, malfunction storylines

effect.zh: 数字干扰和不稳定感。
effect.en: Digital interference and instability.

prompt.zh: A到B加入0.2秒RGB错位与横向故障，随后立即恢复清晰。
prompt.en: Add a 0.2 s RGB split and horizontal glitch from A to B, then return to clean immediately.

pitfalls.zh: 小字号和品牌标志不要长时间变形。
pitfalls.en: Don't distort small text or brand logos for long.

how.zh: 1 A像素块由细变粗。2 粗块峰值切B。3 B像素块缩小至清晰。
how.en: 1 A's pixel blocks grow from fine to coarse. 2 Cut to B at the coarsest point. 3 B's blocks shrink back to sharp.

use_when.zh: 游戏、科技、复古像素风
use_when.en: Gaming, tech, retro pixel style

effect.zh: 数字化分解再重组。
effect.en: Digital break-down and reassembly.

prompt.zh: A像素化至大色块后切B，再恢复清晰，总长0.5秒。
prompt.en: Pixelate A into large blocks, cut to B, then return to sharp; 0.5 s total.

pitfalls.zh: 不适合需要持续读字的画面。
pitfalls.en: Not for frames where text must stay readable.

how.zh: 1 A与B相邻布局。2 两者同速向左移动一屏。3 缓动落稳B。
how.en: 1 Lay A and B side by side. 2 Move both left by one screen at the same speed. 3 Ease B into place.

use_when.zh: 教程步骤、产品功能、信息卡片
use_when.en: Tutorial steps, product features, info cards

effect.zh: 明确表达顺序与空间关系。
effect.en: Clearly expresses sequence and spatial relationship.

prompt.zh: A向左移出，B从右同步推入，0.4秒缓动落稳。
prompt.en: A moves out to the left as B pushes in from the right in sync, easing in over 0.4 s.

pitfalls.zh: 与擦除不同，两个画面都在移动。
pitfalls.en: Unlike a wipe, both images move.

how.zh: 1 B放A下层。2 直线蒙版从左向右扫过。3 A逐渐被B替换。
how.en: 1 Put B below A. 2 Sweep a straight-edge mask from left to right. 3 A is progressively replaced by B.

use_when.zh: 章节切换、图表、品牌动画
use_when.en: Chapter changes, charts, brand animation

effect.zh: 清楚利落地替换画面。
effect.en: Replaces the image cleanly and crisply.

prompt.zh: 用从左向右的直线擦除将A替换成B，0.4秒，边缘清晰。
prompt.en: Replace A with B using a left-to-right linear wipe, 0.4 s, crisp edge.

pitfalls.zh: 画面主体不需要跟随边界移动。
pitfalls.en: The subject doesn't need to follow the wipe edge.

how.zh: 1 建圆形遮罩。2 圆心放在视觉重点。3 半径从零扩大至全屏。
how.en: 1 Create a circular mask. 2 Centre it on the focal point. 3 Grow the radius from zero to full frame.

use_when.zh: 童趣、复古、强调局部、圆形品牌元素
use_when.en: Playful, retro, spotlighting a detail, circular brand elements

effect.zh: 聚焦主体后揭开下一场景。
effect.en: Focuses on the subject, then reveals the next scene.

prompt.zh: 以B主体为圆心，圆形遮罩从小到大擦出B，0.5秒。
prompt.en: Centred on B's subject, a circular mask grows from small to large to reveal B, 0.5 s.

pitfalls.zh: 圆心需匹配视觉焦点。
pitfalls.en: The centre must match the visual focal point.

how.zh: 1 建扇形蒙版。2 围绕中心旋转展开。3 满一圈后完全露出B。
how.en: 1 Create a sector mask. 2 Rotate it open around the centre. 3 B is fully revealed after one full turn.

use_when.zh: 计时、阶段切换、图形演示
use_when.en: Timers, stage changes, graphic demos

effect.zh: 暗示时间推进或步骤完成。
effect.en: Implies time passing or a step completed.

prompt.zh: 从12点方向顺时针扇形擦出B，0.6秒完成一圈。
prompt.en: Clockwise sector wipe from 12 o'clock reveals B, completing one turn in 0.6 s.

pitfalls.zh: 中心位置应固定。
pitfalls.en: Keep the centre fixed.

how.zh: 1 将A、B贴到相邻立方体面。2 摄像机保持固定。3 立方体转90度切至B。
how.en: 1 Map A and B onto adjacent faces of a cube. 2 Keep the camera fixed. 3 Rotate the cube 90° to reach B.

use_when.zh: 功能模块、演示片、复古数字视觉
use_when.en: Feature modules, demo videos, retro digital visuals

effect.zh: 强调页面或空间翻转。
effect.en: Emphasises a page or space flipping over.

prompt.zh: 将A与B贴到立方体相邻面，向左旋转90度，0.5秒。
prompt.en: Map A and B onto adjacent cube faces and rotate 90° to the left, 0.5 s.

pitfalls.zh: 这是平面贴图的3D效果，不是真实镜头穿越。
pitfalls.en: This is a 3D effect on flat textures, not a real camera move through space.

how.zh: 1 A作为可弯曲页面。2 动画化页角翻折与阴影。3 展露下方B。
how.en: 1 Treat A as a bendable page. 2 Animate the corner curl and shadow. 3 Reveal B underneath.

use_when.zh: 相册、书籍、故事章节、教育
use_when.en: Photo albums, books, story chapters, education

effect.zh: 产生翻阅和回顾感。
effect.en: A sense of leafing through and looking back.

prompt.zh: 把A像书页一样从右向左翻开，露出B，带柔和阴影，0.7秒。
prompt.en: Turn A like a book page from right to left to reveal B, with a soft shadow, 0.7 s.

pitfalls.zh: 页面几何和阴影应一致。
pitfalls.en: Page geometry and shadows must be consistent.

how.zh: 1 取A末帧、B首帧。2 输入支持首尾帧的模型。3 描述唯一运动路径，生成后修剪接缝。
how.en: 1 Take A's last frame and B's first frame. 2 Feed them to a model that supports first/last frames. 3 Describe a single motion path, then trim the seam after generation.

use_when.zh: 门洞穿越、建筑空间、奇幻广告
use_when.en: Flying through doorways, architectural spaces, fantasy ads

effect.zh: 生成原素材没有的连续空间运动。
effect.en: Generates continuous spatial motion that the original footage doesn't have.

prompt.zh: 从A末帧向前穿过门洞，连续推进至B首帧，镜头平稳。
prompt.en: From A's last frame, move forward through the doorway, continuously advancing to B's first frame, with a steady camera.

duration.en: Generate 2–5 s, then pick a section

pitfalls.zh: 时长按模型支持；检查结构变形和接缝跳动。
pitfalls.en: Duration depends on model support; check for structural warping and seam jumps.

how.zh: 1 选择轮廓相近的A、B主体。2 提供首尾参考。3 限定背景与镜头，生成形态变化。
how.en: 1 Choose A and B subjects with similar silhouettes. 2 Provide first and last reference frames. 3 Lock background and camera, then generate the transformation.

use_when.zh: 创意商品概念、超现实广告、MV
use_when.en: Creative product concepts, surreal ads, music videos

effect.zh: 一个主体连续变成另一个。
effect.en: One subject continuously turns into another.

prompt.zh: 固定镜头，让A主体平滑变为B主体，保持中心、光线和背景不变。
prompt.en: Locked camera; A's subject smoothly transforms into B's subject, keeping centre, lighting and background unchanged.

duration.en: Generate 2–5 s, then pick a section

pitfalls.zh: 与采访Morph Cut不同；不要假定品牌字样可精确保留。
pitfalls.en: Different from an interview Morph Cut; don't assume brand text will be preserved exactly.

how.zh: 1 锁定主体位置与镜头。2 准备新旧环境参考。3 只描述环境变化，再核对主体一致性。
how.en: 1 Lock subject position and camera. 2 Prepare old and new environment references. 3 Describe only the environment change, then check subject consistency.

use_when.zh: 季节更替、日夜变化、同地点时间流逝
use_when.en: Changing seasons, day to night, time passing in one place

effect.zh: 保持视觉锚点，同时改变时空。
effect.en: Keeps the visual anchor while changing time and place.

prompt.zh: 固定构图和主体，环境从A的白天连续变为B的夜晚，光线平滑变化。
prompt.en: Fixed composition and subject; the environment changes continuously from A's daytime to B's night, with lighting shifting smoothly.

duration.en: Generate 2–5 s, then pick a section

pitfalls.zh: 生成式方案为编辑建议；一致性需筛选结果。
pitfalls.en: Generative approaches are editorial suggestions; select results for consistency.
